function.description: Read an agent. source screen (the default): the last lines of its terminal pane, for what it is doing right now and what it is asking. source session: its own session record, for what it said, found or changed: its last message for a human in full, the last instruction it received, and the files it edited.
function.name: read_screen

lines.description: screen only: how many lines from the bottom (default 200)

function.description: Ask a read-only CLI agent a question about the agent's repository (diff, logs, why a test fails). Slow (tens of seconds). Phrase the question with full context: the CLI has not heard this conversation.
function.name: run_cli

function.description: The roster: every agent with its state, task and pending question.
function.name: list_agents

function.description: Search the record: last results, last tasks, last questions, notes, promises and earlier transcript lines matching the query.
function.name: recall

query.description: words to look for; empty for the most recent record

function.description: Send an instruction to an agent as typed text. Its own approval prompts still apply. Use for anything the CEO tells an agent to do.
function.name: prompt

function.description: Answer an agent's approval prompt with the keys of one of its on-screen options (see the roster). Permitted only when the CEO authorised that answer in this turn.
function.name: send_keys

items.description: one key name, e.g. enter, esc, y, 1

function.description: Send Ctrl-C to an agent to stop what it is doing.
function.name: interrupt

function.description: Record promised work: the CEO asked to be told when something happens to an agent ("tell me when it's done", "let me know if it asks", "remind me"). The supervisor keeps it: it tells the CEO at the next matching event, whatever the chattiness level. Use it in the same turn as any instruction that goes with it.
function.name: promise

due_in_minutes.description: only when the CEO gave a deadline or asked to be interrupted at once (0); a promise kept past its due time interrupts instead of waiting for a pause

event.description: the condition: done (it finished), blocked (it asks something), idle, or any_change

text.description: what the CEO asked to be told, in their words

function.description: Start a background look into something the screen cannot answer and that may take more than a few seconds. source cli (the default): a fresh read-only CLI agent in the agent's repository, for questions about the code itself. source worker: the worker's own session, asked through a read-only copy that remembers everything it saw and did, for why it did something, what it tried, or to explain its decision; it never touches the worker. It returns at once with a job id; the answer reaches the CEO on its own when the job returns, so acknowledge with pending true and say roughly how long. Phrase the question with full context: neither has heard this conversation. One live investigation per agent.
function.name: investigate

follow_up_of.description: the id of the investigation this digs deeper into, to resume the same session

source.description: cli (default, the repository) or worker (the worker's own memory)

function.description: Remember something the CEO decided or wants kept in mind ("remember the migrations are off limits today", "we are on the release branch"). Notes are in the ledger of every later turn. Not for promised work: that is promise.
function.name: note

text.description: what to remember, in the CEO's words
